sections.title: General Information
paragraphs: Filing Of Forms To Be Issued To Montana Residents Insured Under Group Policy Delivered Out-Of-State:
In accordance with Montana Insurance Code §33-1-501, enclosed for approval on a single case basis, is the certificate in final
printed form. The Group Policy provides Group Level Term Life and Dependent Life Insurance.
Upon your approval, the certificate form G-31272-0/GMR/CERT-MT will be issued to Montana residents who become insured
under a group policy which is issued for delivery of Ohio to ASM International (“ASM”). ASM is a group that meets the
requirements of Montana Insurance Code §33-20-1112. The group documents are attached to the Supporting Documentation
These forms are new and do not replace any form previously filed or approved by your department. I am pleased to certify that
the forms have been reviewed and approved by the contract state of Ohio on June 11, 2025.
New York Life will be marketing the forms to ASM members via direct mail solicitation. This is to certify that solicitation of
insurance for Montana residents will not be made until approval of this filing is received from your Department.
Upon approval, we are requesting an extension of approval of application form GMA-PRS1, which was previously approved by
your department on July 07, 2003, which is attached to the Supporting Documentation tab for reference.
Thank you in advance for your attention to this matter.

blocks.text: In accordance with Montana Insurance Code §33-1-501, enclosed for approval on a single case basis, is the certificate in final
printed form. The Group Policy provides Group Level Term Life and Dependent Life Insurance.
Upon your approval, the certificate form G-31272-0/GMR/CERT-MT will be issued to Montana residents who become insured
under a group policy which is issued for delivery of Ohio to ASM International (“ASM”). ASM is a group that meets the
requirements of Montana Insurance Code §33-20-1112. The group documents are attached to the Supporting Documentation
These forms are new and do not replace any form previously filed or approved by your department. I am pleased to certify that
the forms have been reviewed and approved by the contract state of Ohio on June 11, 2025.
New York Life will be marketing the forms to ASM members via direct mail solicitation. This is to certify that solicitation of
insurance for Montana residents will not be made until approval of this filing is received from your Department.
Upon approval, we are requesting an extension of approval of application form GMA-PRS1, which was previously approved by
your department on July 07, 2003, which is attached to the Supporting Documentation tab for reference.
Thank you in advance for your attention to this matter.
